usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and Poe receives a prompt for a model through “Generate Chat Response”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Generate Chat Response” in Poe
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order can get an AI-written reply drafted from its details.

watchOut: “Generate Chat Response” in Poe only writes the reply, so a later step sends it, after approval if external.
